title: Wireless Charging
definition: Wireless charging (or inductive charging) is a technology that transfers electrical energy from a power source to a receiving device without a physical cable, typically utilizing electromagnetic fields and resonant inductive coupling.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for Science and Technology (GS Paper III) covering emerging technologies, energy efficiency, Internet of Things (IoT), Electric Vehicles (EVs), and telecommunications standards.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Wireless Charging.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Alternating Current (AC) and Direct Current (DC) principles
